segments.text:
Another Conſideration for the working of Contenement, it is, To conſider that we have but a little be time in this world: If thou beeſt godly thou ſhalt never ſuffer but only in this world; why do but ſhut your eyes and preſently another life is come: as that Martyr ſaid to his fellow Martyr, Do but ſhut your eyes, (ſaith he) & the next time they are opened you ſhall be in another
world. Athanaſius ſaith, it is but a little cloud (when he was baniſhed) and it will be over (notwithſtanding) preſently. Theſe Afflictions they are but for a moment? a Marriner when he is abroad doth not think it much if a ſtorm ariſes, eſpecially if he can ſee the Heavens cleer beyond it ſaith he, it will be over preſently: Conſider we have not long to live, it may be it may be over before our daies be at an end, but ſuppoſe it ſhould not, death will put an end to all, all Afflictions and troubles will ſoon be at an end by death.
